prompts.title: Bemutatkozás
prompts.situation: You are meeting someone for the first time.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are meeting someone for the first time.

Task: Answer questions about yourself. Include: your name and nationality; where you live; your work or studies; the languages you speak; your hobbies.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: A családom
prompts.situation: You are showing someone a photograph of your family.
prompts.task: Describe the people in the photograph.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are showing someone a photograph of your family.

Task: Describe the people in the photograph. Include: who they are; their names and ages; where they live; what they do; what you like doing together.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: A kedvenc helyem
prompts.situation: Someone asks you about your favourite place in your town or city.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Someone asks you about your favourite place in your town or city.

Task: Describe the place. Include: where it is; what it looks like; what you can do there; when you go there; why you like it.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Egy átlagos nap
prompts.situation: Your teacher asks you to describe a normal day.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Your teacher asks you to describe a normal day.

Task: Describe your typical day. Include: when you get up; your morning; your afternoon; your evening; what you enjoy most.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Mit csináljunk hétvégén?
prompts.situation: You and another person want to do something together at the weekend.
prompts.task: Discuss possible activities and choose one. ====================
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You and another person want to do something together at the weekend.

Task: Discuss possible activities and choose one. ==================== Include: what you like doing; what you do not like; when you are free; where you could go; which activity you prefer.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Egy emlékezetes nap
prompts.situation: A Hungarian-speaking friend asks you about a day you remember well.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: A Hungarian-speaking friend asks you about a day you remember well.

Task: Tell your friend about it. Include: when and where it happened; who you were with; what happened; how you felt; why you remember it.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: Kép leírása és történet
prompts.situation: You are given a photograph showing people in a public place.
prompts.task: Describe the photograph and imagine what is happening.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are given a photograph showing people in a public place.

Task: Describe the photograph and imagine what is happening. Include: where the people are; what they are doing; what they might be saying; what happened before the photograph; what might happen afterwards.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: Tervezzünk egy napot!
prompts.situation: You and another person have a free day and want to spend it together.
prompts.task: Discuss the possibilities and make a plan.
points: which plan you prefer and why
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You and another person have a free day and want to spend it together.

Task: Discuss the possibilities and make a plan. Include: where you could go; what you could do; how you could travel; how much time you have; which plan you prefer and why.

Speak for approximately 2-3 minutes.

prompts.title: Probléma utazás közben
prompts.situation: Imagine that you are travelling and something goes wrong.
prompts.task: Explain the situation and say what you would do.
points: you miss a train or bus
you arrive at the wrong hotel
who you would ask for help
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Imagine that you are travelling and something goes wrong.

Task: Explain the situation and say what you would do. Include: you lose your luggage; you miss a train or bus; you lose your phone; you arrive at the wrong hotel; what happened; what you need; who you would ask for help; what you would do next.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: Szabadidő
prompts.situation: You are discussing how to spend your free time.
prompts.task: Compare two possible activities, such as staying at home or going out with friends. ====================
points: what you normally do in your free time
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are discussing how to spend your free time.

Task: Compare two possible activities, such as staying at home or going out with friends. ==================== Include: what you can do; the advantages of each option; what you prefer; why you prefer it; what you normally do in your free time.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: Egy fontos élmény
prompts.situation: The examiner asks you to talk about an experience that was important to you.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: The examiner asks you to talk about an experience that was important to you.

Task: Give a short presentation. Include: what the experience was; when and where it happened; who was involved; what happened; why it was important; what you learned from it.

Speak for approximately 2-3 minutes.

prompts.title: Nyaralás megtervezése
prompts.situation: You and another person want to organise a holiday together. You have several possible options, such as a beach holiday, a city trip, a countryside trip or an activity holiday.
prompts.task: Discuss the options and reach a decision. Agree on one option and explain your decision.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You and another person want to organise a holiday together. You have several possible options, such as a beach holiday, a city trip, a countryside trip or an activity holiday.

Task: Discuss the options and reach a decision. Agree on one option and explain your decision. Include: the advantages of different options; possible disadvantages; cost; transport; activities; your personal preferences.

Speak for approximately 3-4 minutes.

prompts.title: Otthoni munkavégzés
prompts.situation: You have been asked to discuss whether working from home is a good option for employees.
prompts.task: Give your opinion and discuss the issue. Give reasons and examples.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You have been asked to discuss whether working from home is a good option for employees.

Task: Give your opinion and discuss the issue. Give reasons and examples. Include: advantages for workers; possible disadvantages; productivity; communication and social interaction; your own experience or expectations.

Speak for approximately 2-3 minutes.

prompts.title: Egy közös rendezvény
prompts.situation: Your school, workplace or local community wants to organise an event to bring people together.
prompts.task: Discuss how you would organise it. Work together to agree on a plan.
points: what kind of event to organise
where and when it should take place
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Your school, workplace or local community wants to organise an event to bring people together.

Task: Discuss how you would organise it. Work together to agree on a plan. Include: what kind of event to organise; where and when it should take place; who should be invited; activities and entertainment; food and drink; how to advertise it.

Speak for approximately 3-4 minutes.

prompts.title: Megoldás egy problémára
prompts.situation: A group of young people in your city are having difficulty finding affordable ways to spend their free time.
prompts.task: Discuss possible solutions. Explain which solutions could be useful and why. Respond to the other person's suggestions and reach an agreement.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: A group of young people in your city are having difficulty finding affordable ways to spend their free time.

Task: Discuss possible solutions. Explain which solutions could be useful and why. Respond to the other person's suggestions and reach an agreement. Include: sports and fitness activities; cultural events; public spaces; clubs and community activities; online activities.

Speak for approximately 3-4 minutes.
